notes.title: New upcoming game - Breeding Visa
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/ad1afbcfa106fb1660df1553ca668f000b3c7d9a.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3785660/Breeding_Visa/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/3f2fe354a1fbd398640e2f71b3a848cd1c15027a.png[/img]

[h1]Sex. Sex is always needed.[/h1]

A nation once known for its traditions and technological marvels thrived, its cities buzzing with life and its streets filled with busy crowds. Bullet trains sliced through misty mountains, neon-lit cities hummed with robotic servers, and engineers built AI companions fluent in a dozen languages.

But sex is always needed.

Over decades, people stopped connecting. Romance faded into memory. Dating apps shut down. Birth rates flatlined. Sex became a rumour, a half-remembered chore from a bygone era. By the year 2042, the silence grew deafening: an entire generation had forgotten how to want, how to touch, how to fuck. The government's answer was as radical as it was crude. The [i][b]Breeding Visa[/b] Program[/i]: a last-ditch program inviting foreign men to step into the void. No one pretended it was elegant. Locals weren't lining up for romance - they'd buried that instinct years ago. The task fell to outsiders: penetrate the apathy, spark desire where none existed, and plant the seeds of survival.

You are part of this awkward experiment. Your qualifications? A pulse, working anatomy, and the patience to teach what's been erased. The women here aren't shy. They're oblivious. Flirting? Foreplay? The missionary position? Lost knowledge, like hieroglyphics. Your job isn't just to fuck - it's to reboot a cultural libido from scratch. It won't be pretty. Expect blank stares when you unzip. Confusion over where things go. Women who'd rather binge streaming dramas than grind against a stranger. But the government's counting on you. Incentives are offered. And beneath the awkwardness? A flicker of curiosity. Maybe even hunger. The clock's ticking. Seduce a society that's forgotten how to feel. Or watch a civilisation fade into virginity.

Your life is about to change.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/ded825268af44a35b9c48a63ca065f42df056ca5.png[/img]

[h1]You Are the Catalyst[/h1]

Armed with a controversial past and an assertive personality, you’ll pursue reluctant women across a society obsessed with work and devoid of passion. Break through their apathy using any means necessary, persuasion, manipulation, or sheer dominance. Your visa depends on results.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/1adc528b9aef5d641ce7e43f21629d30b074904b.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay Experience[/h1]

[i]Breeding Visa[/i] delivers a classic choice-driven visual novel with deep narrative branching

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/87b7403f87bd187a6d423c3b713ecb03a9b80684.png[/img]

[h1]Key Features:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [u][b]Seduction[/b][/u]: Target distinct women like the icy bureaucrat Yumiko, the rigid landlady Sakura, the anxious clerk Ami, and the hostile lifeguard Rin. Overcome their unique hangups through dialogue choices and escalating encounters.

[*] [u][b]Explicit Consequences[/b][/u]: Your choices lead to graphic scenes of exhibitionism, steamy encounters, and raw sex.

[*] [u][b]Save or Doom a Nation[/b][/u]: Your success determines this nation's survival. Will you spark a sexual revolution or watch civilisation fade into sterile oblivion?

[*] [u][b]Branching Paths[/b][/u]: Virginity, pregnancy, or societal collapse hinge on your strategy.

[*] [u][b]Uncompromising Adult Content[/b][/u]: Features uncensored sex, nudity, and adult themes.
[/list]

notes.title: Seducing My Elf Family now available
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that [b]Seducing My Elf Family[/b] is now available on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3458860/Seducing_My_Elf_Family

[i]Twenty years ago, your father disappeared without a trace, leaving you and your mother to pick up the pieces. For two decades, there was no word, no sign of him - until he suddenly reappeared with a new family. He had started a life in another world, taking an elven wife and fathering two half-elf daughters, your half-sisters.

Tragically, he died not long after his return, leaving you alone to navigate life with this new and unexpected family. Your life was already strange enough, living with an elven step-mother and two half-elf sisters, but one day, a magical debt collector shows up at your door with the worst news possible. Your father’s unfinished business isn’t just about money, it’s about your family. And now, unless you can pull off the impossible, they’re about to be taken away forever.

You have a short time to form bonds stronger than the magical covenant that binds them. But let’s be honest, this isn’t about bonding over family dinners. You’ll have to seduce your elven step-mother and sisters, breaking through their defenses, exploring every intimate secret and perhaps appreciating the sensual charm of delicate elven feet. It’s a race against time, a battle of charm and forbidden passion, and an adventure unlike anything you’ve faced before. This visual novel delivers a unique mix of storytelling and seductive encounters.[/i]

notes.title: New upcoming game - Teach Me Master
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/8b5bd5e736adf7fe17b5902b11e1e49089e6c1c7.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3591090/Teach_Me_Master/

An adult visual novel blending martial arts, passion, and redemption.

You're Russell (name customizable) and were once a professional fighter, climbing the ranks and making a name for yourself. A humiliating loss shattered your career, sending everything spiraling out of control. Sponsors pulled their support, and opportunities disappeared overnight. With no clear direction, you drifted from one meaningless night to the next. When a couple of drunk fans pushed you too far at a bar, you snapped. By the time it was over, they were the ones left broken, and you were facing serious jail time.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/c53e8a4718d9108fd339044773d5d7feb4c2df5a.png[/img]

Instead of prison, an unexpected deal gave you another option. A judge offered an alternative sentence: provide self-defense training to women for free. It wasn’t what you wanted, but it kept you out of a cell. With no other choice, you accepted.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/b22c59ea83d2b82481827c36a8319a21744501d1.png[/img]

Your first trainee, Naomi, already has some martial arts experience. She knows the techniques but struggles with confidence. At first, the training is just a requirement to fulfill, but as you work together, you see potential in her. With the right guidance, she could become a serious competitor. While you try to focus on coaching, past troubles refuse to stay in the past. Your loan shark doesn’t care about your situation and demands repayment, with no patience for excuses.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/07d2ef92e49383fdfdee7004da6471555ebc1074.png[/img]

Desperate for a way to fix everything, you come up with a plan. Naomi has skill, and professional fighting pays well. If she competes, she can earn real money. She needs a manager, and with your experience, you are the right person for the job. Training intensifies as you push her to reach her limits, sharpening both her technique and her mindset. She is strong, but the road to becoming a true fighter is brutal. Every day brings new challenges, both inside and outside the ring.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/675496ef61d056435ee9b030273c90bc975e8b92.png[/img]

Spending so much time together strengthens your bond with Naomi. Long hours, shared struggles, and physical training sessions create an undeniable closeness. The connection between you deepens, and attraction grows. The choices you make will shape your relationship and define how everything unfolds.

This is a choice-driven visual novel where every decision has consequences. Multiple endings allow for different outcomes, depending on how you handle each situation. Training, relationships, and personal struggles all come into play as the story progresses. The fight world is unforgiving, and your past still lingers, but every moment is another chance to take control of your future.

Martial arts is more than just fighting. It is discipline, strategy, and mental resilience. Everything you do will influence the story, from how you train Naomi to how you deal with the people from your past. The journey ahead is intense, but the path forward is yours to decide.

notes.title: New upcoming game - Whispers of the Citadel
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I am happy to announce my new game titled [b]Whispers of the Citadel[/b]. As the name suggests, it is set after the events of [b]Whispers of an Elven Captor[/b]. It contains a much wider range of love interests (five in total), much less linear storyline (six endings), and is much longer in length (3.5x longer). So if you're interested please check it out and wishlist it.

Thanks.

JellyFluff

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670700/Whispers_of_the_Citadel

notes.title: We did it! Why is reaching 10 reviews so important?
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has left a review for Whispers of an Elven Captor so far. Getting to 10 reviews is the first milestone that we are aiming for. The first 10 reviews are very important as there is a big visibility boost by Steam when that number is reached. I'm hoping that we get there (Edit: We did!). It has to be from paying players though - curators and free keys do not count. 

[url=https://howtomarketagame.com/2022/01/25/why-your-first-10-reviews-are-the-most-important/]Why your first 10 reviews are the most important[/url]

In other news I have been working on a sequel to this game, though with different characters but much bigger in scope. I think I'm close to be able to put up a store page for it but there's just a few more things I need to work on. That's all I have for now. Thanks.

JellyFluff

notes.title: Whispers of an Elven Captor is now available
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that Whispers of an Elven Captor is now available.

I would like to thank the curators who have left reviews of the game, as well as everyone who has added the game to their wishlist. It has been very motivating for me.

This is now my second game I have released on Steam and I have tried to apply what I learned during my first experience to this game. I hope you enjoy playing the game so please leave a review letting me know your thoughts and feedback.

I have already started work on my third game which will be set in the same universe as this game, and I hope to have the store page up in the coming weeks.

Let me know what you think but otherwise enjoy!

JellyFluff

notes.title: Upcoming release
notes.notes:
The planned release of Whispers of an Elven Captor is now less than a day away and I just wanted to let everyone know that the release is still on schedule.

I have made some last minute changes to the build based upon some feedback by curators - mostly typo fixes but I have also added a replay function for certain scenes.

I hope everyone enjoys the game. It was definitely fun to make.

JellyFluff
